verdict.rationale: A tax agency with an online filing portal and a tax-software-developer channel could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a browser-based Taxpayer Portal behind authenticated sessions, XML file uploads, and probes that found no llms.txt, markdown docs or OpenAPI spec; no official CLI is mentioned anywhere.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
